subject: Buying in the South Bay again
body:

subject: catching up, and what I've been buying
body:
Hi Ryan,

Ryan LaRocca with LRG Homes. It's been a minute, so a proper update. Over the last year I picked up a six unit building on Kirkland Ave in Sunnyvale, a house on Ridgeview in San Jose, and another on Limewood. Different situations, same pattern each time: bought as-is, closed fast, nobody had to deal with a repair list or a financing scare.

What I'm after now is more of the same. Single family and 2 to 15 unit buildings in San Jose, Sunnyvale, Santa Clara, Campbell, Los Gatos, and I'll stretch to the rest of the Bay for the right one under about four million. Condition is irrelevant. Tenants are fine. Probate, divorce, deferred maintenance, a seller who's tired, all fine.

What I'd really like is to sit down with you for half an hour and hear what you're seeing out there. Which neighborhoods are stalling, which sellers are getting impatient, what's coming that hasn't hit the MLS yet. I'll buy lunch anywhere near your office.

And if there's something on your desk right now that's been a headache, I'm a text away.

Ryan LaRocca
LRG Homes
(650) 910-4007
